{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS176 |prevtitle=The Last Battle X |nextcode=PS178 |nexttitle=The Last Battle XII |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Last Battle XI |title_ja=最終決戦XI |title_ro=The Last Battle XI |image=PS177.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 177 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 177 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |location=[[Ilex Forest]] }} '''The Last Battle XI''' (Japanese: '''最終決戦XI''' ''The Last Battle XI'') is the 177th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 87th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Green}} notices {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}} below her, and orders {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Articuno}} and {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Zapdos}} to pick them up. With Red on Articuno and Blue on Zapdos, a combined blast from the {{adv|legendary birds}} is launched towards {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}}, whose {{m|Sacred Fire}} struggles to contain it. {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}} delivers an {{m|Aeroblast}} to combine with Ho-Oh's Sacred Fire and fend off the legendary birds' attacks. Green almost falls off {{p|Moltres}}, and Ho-Oh intercepts Red and Blue's attempt to help her. Red and Blue eventually realize the significance of the [[Ilex Forest shrine|shrine]] they resurfaced next to. [[Karen]] jumps onto Moltres to face Green. She sends her {{p|Umbreon}} out to once again face Green's {{p|Snubbull}}. Umbreon, charged with {{m|Moonlight}}, knocks Green and her Snubbull off Moltres. Meanwhile on Lugia, [[Will]] orders a {{m|Peck}} from his {{p|Xatu}} towards {{adv|Silver}}, but his {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}} blocks the attack with its claws. Will taunts Silver over the latter's time in the outside world; Silver retorts saying that life under the [[Masked Man]] will forever haunt him. Will, however, claims that he and Karen willingly became the [[Masked Man]]'s accomplices. Knowing this as a direct contradiction to his belief that his former colleagues were also kidnapped, Silver no longer holds back. He pushes Will and Xatu off Lugia. Xatu tries to catch Will's fall, but Silver's Pokémon pop out of their [[Poké Ball]]s to {{m|Beat Up|beat up}} the bird. With new-found determination, Silver states that unlike Will, who merely sees their battle as a game, he sees his battle as one against his own destiny. With that {{TP|Silver|Feraligatr}} knocks Xatu out with {{m|Return}}. Will's response to the well-prepared Silver is to run away, thus he contacts Karen via [[Pokégear]] to urge her to do the same. Meanwhile, {{adv|Yellow}} arrives at the forest, wondering if [[Pika]], [[Chuchu]], and the [[Day-Care Couple]] are safe. ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} gets paired with {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Articuno}}, {{adv|Green}} gets paired with {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Moltres}}, and {{adv|Blue}} gets paired with {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Zapdos}} to battle {{adv|Tower duo|Lugia, Ho-Oh}}, and the [[Masked Man]]. * {{adv|Yellow}} reaches [[Ilex Forest]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Silver}} * [[Karen]] * [[Will]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Snubbull}} ({{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Articuno}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Articuno|Green's}}) * {{p|Zapdos}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Zapdos|Green's}}) * {{p|Moltres}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Moltres|Green's}}) * {{p|Sneasel}} ({{OP|Silver|Sneasel}}) * {{p|Kingdra}} ({{adv|Silver}}'s) * {{p|Murkrow}} ({{OP|Silver|Murkrow}}) * {{p|Feraligatr}} ({{OP|Silver|Feraligatr}}) * {{p|Ursaring}} ({{OP|Silver|Ursaring}}) * {{p|Gyarados}} ({{OP|Silver|Gyarados}}; [[Red Gyarados]]) * {{p|Umbreon}} ([[Karen]]'s) * {{p|Xatu}} ([[Will]]'s) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Masked Man's}}) * {{p|Lugia}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia|Masked Man's}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|最終決戰 XI|The Last Battle XI}} (Taiwan)
